mcqs.question: Who founded Sarvam AI, the Bengaluru-based company established in 2023?
mcqs.explanation: Sarvam AI was established in Bengaluru in 2023 by Vivek Raghavan and Pratyush Kumar. Gurdeep Singh, P.R. Hari, Ashwini Vaishnaw, Sarbananda Sonowal and Nitin Gadkari are associated with other organisations or offices, not as the founders of Sarvam AI.
